method: WebFetch (page text only) and WebSearch snippets. No file, image or dataset was downloaded or stored from any external source, and no receipt image or OCR text was sent anywhere. 'verified' below means what was actually read on the page; 'search snippet' means it was only seen in a search result and is NOT verified.
headline: No public dataset of authentic Indian petrol/diesel receipts was found. Public Indian fuel-receipt material consists of bill GENERATORS (simulated receipts). Generic receipt datasets (SROIE, CORD, others) contain non-Indian shop/restaurant receipts and were not downloaded.

phase2_search.purpose: Find AUTHORIZED sources of authentic Nayara, Jio-bp, Shell and independent-station receipts.
phase2_search.local: All 8 distinct company Expense Report PDFs in the project (ER-39832, ER-40223, ER-40706, ER-40782, ER-40513, ER-41115, ER-41220, ER-38784) were already used; the remaining PDFs are trip reports or synthetic test files, and backups/uat copies are byte-identical duplicates (same SHA-256). No additional authentic receipts exist locally.
phase2_search.public_result: NONE FOUND. Searches of Wikimedia Commons (search page: 50 of 139 results, none a fuel receipt), Hugging Face, Kaggle, Roboflow and GitHub returned no dataset of authentic Indian (or any) fuel-station receipts under a usable licence.

not_used.note: 192 generic receipt images with 3,839 boxes, CC0 1.0 per the page, built on the 'Express Expense' sample receipts; country and receipt types are not stated (no mention of fuel or India) and access is behind a form. Not requested or downloaded.
A Scribd upload of an Indian fuel receipt; Scribd marks such uploads all rights reserved. Not used.
Commercial vendor sample of generic receipts; fuel/India content and licence not established. Not used.
200 restaurant receipt photos; licence not read; not fuel, not Indian. Not used.

phase2_search.consequence: New authentic coverage added in this phase: 0 receipts. An intake workflow with enforced provenance exists (intake/INTAKE.md) so an authorized person can supply them; until then Nayara, Jio-bp, Shell and unfamiliar independent stations are exercised only by SYNTHETIC receipts.
